title: सप्ताधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Dhritarashtra recalls the insults the Pandavas bore in exile and wonders at the Kaurava defeats. Sanjaya describes the horses and bodies strewn over the field as Bhima and Karna fight on.
summary.kn: ಪಾಂಡವರು ವನವಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಹಿಸಿದ ಅವಮಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ ನೆನೆದು ಕೌರವರ ಸೋಲಿಗೆ ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯಪಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಭೀಮ-ಕರ್ಣರು ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವಾಗ ರಣರಂಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಚದುರಿದ ಕುದುರೆ, ಶವಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಜಯ ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: धृतराष्ट्र वनवास में पाण्डवों द्वारा सहे अपमानों को याद करते हैं और कौरवों की पराजयों पर चकित होते हैं। भीम-कर्ण के लड़ते समय संजय रणभूमि में बिखरे घोड़ों और शवों का वर्णन करते हैं।
summary.te: వనవాసంలో పాండవులు సహించిన అవమానాలను ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు గుర్తు చేసుకుని కౌరవ పరాజయాలకు ఆశ్చర్యపడతాడు. భీమ కర్ణులు పోరాడుతుండగా రణభూమిలో చెల్లాచెదురైన గుర్రాలు, శవాలను సంజయుడు వర్ణిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: வனவாசத்தில் பாண்டவர் சகித்த அவமானங்களைத் த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் நினைத்து, கௌரவத் தோல்விகளுக்கு வியக்கிறான். பீமனும் கர்ணனும் போரிடுகையில் களத்தில் சிதறிய குதிரைகள், உடல்களைச் சஞ்சயன் விவரிக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: വനവാസകാലത്ത് പാണ്ഡവർ സഹിച്ച അപമാനങ്ങൾ ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ ഓർക്കുന്നു; കൗരവ പരാജയങ്ങളിൽ അദ്ദേഹം അത്ഭുതപ്പെടുന്നു. ഭീമനും കർണ്ണനും പൊരുതുമ്പോൾ കുതിരകളും ശവങ്ങളും രണഭൂമിയിൽ ചിതറിക്കിടക്കുന്നതായി സഞ്ജയൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.107; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
यस्मिञ्जयाशा सततं पुत्राणां मम संजय ।
तं दृष्ट्वा विमुखं संख्ये किं नु दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत् ।
कर्णो वा समरे तात किमकार्षीदतः परम् ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, he in whom my sons always place their hope of victory, seeing him turned away in the battle, what did Duryodhana say? Or what did Karna do next in the fight, dear friend?

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
भीमसेनं रणे दृष्ट्वा ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम् ।
रथमन्यं समास्थाय विधिवत्कल्पितं पुनः ।
अभ्ययात्पाण्डवं कर्णो वातोद्धूत इवार्णवः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Bhimasena blazing like fire in the battle, Karna mounted another chariot, duly fitted out, and again went at the Pandava like an ocean tossed by the wind.

verses.text:
क्रुद्धमाधिरथिं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रास्तव विशां पते ।
भीमसेनममन्यन्त वैवस्वतमुखे हुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the son of Adhiratha angry, your sons, lord of the people, thought Bhimasena as good as offered into the mouth of Vaivasvata.

verses.text:
चापशब्दं महत्कृत्वा तलशब्दं च भैरवम् ।
अभ्यवर्तत राधेयो भीमसेनरथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Making a great twang of his bow and a terrible slap of his palms, Radheya advanced toward Bhimasena's chariot.

verses.text:
पुनरेव ततो राजन्महानासीत्सुदारुणः ।
विमर्दः सूतपुत्रस्य भीमस्य च विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Then again, O king, a great and very dreadful clash arose between the charioteer's son and Bhima, lord of the people.

verses.text:
संरब्धौ हि महाबाहू परस्परवधैषिणौ ।
अन्योन्यमीक्षां चक्राते दहन्ताविव लोचनैः ॥

meaning.en: Both mighty-armed men, furious and wishing to kill each other, looked at one another as if burning with their eyes.

verses.text:
क्रोधरक्तेक्षणौ क्रुद्धौ निःश्वसन्तौ महारथौ ।
युद्धेऽन्योन्यं समासाद्य ततक्षतुररिंदमौ ॥

meaning.en: Their eyes red with anger, the two great chariot-warriors, tamers of foes, breathing hard, closed with each other in the fight and tore at each other.

verses.text:
व्याघ्राविव सुसंरब्धौ श्येनाविव च शीघ्रगौ ।
शरभाविव संक्रुद्धौ युयुधाते परस्परम् ॥

meaning.en: Like two enraged tigers, like two swift hawks, like two furious sharabhas, they fought each other.

verses.text:
ततो भीमः स्मरन्क्लेशानक्षद्यूते वनेऽपि च ।
विराटनगरे चैव प्राप्तं दुःखमरिंदमः ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhima, tamer of foes, remembering the sufferings at the dice game and in the forest, and the misery met in Virata's city,

verses.text:
राष्ट्राणां स्फीतरत्नानां हरणं च तवात्मजैः ।
सततं च परिक्लेशान्सपुत्रेण त्वया कृतान् ॥

meaning.en: and the seizing by your sons of the lands rich in jewels, and the constant torments done by you with your sons,

verses.text:
दग्धुमैच्छश्च यत्कुन्तीं सपुत्रां त्वमनागसम् ।
कृष्णायाश्च परिक्लेशं सभामध्ये दुरात्मभिः ॥

meaning.en: and how you wished to burn the innocent Kunti with her sons, and the torment of Krishna in the midst of the assembly by the evil-minded,

verses.text:
पतिमन्यं परीप्सस्व न सन्ति पतयस्तव ।
नरकं पतिताः पार्थाः सर्वे षण्ढतिलोपमाः ॥

meaning.en: "Seek another husband, you have none: the Parthas have fallen into hell, as worthless as barren sesame," (he remembered what they said,)

verses.text:
समक्षं तव कौरव्य यदूचुः कुरवस्तदा ।
दासीभोगेन कृष्णां च भोक्तुकामाः सुतास्तव ॥

meaning.en: what the Kurus said in your presence, Kaurava, when your sons wanted to enjoy Krishna as a slave woman,

verses.text:
यच्चापि तान्प्रव्रजतः कृष्णाजिननिवासिनः ।
परुषाण्युक्तवान्कर्णः सभायां संनिधौ तव ॥

meaning.en: and the harsh words Karna spoke in your presence in the assembly to them as they left, clothed in black-antelope skins,

verses.text:
तृणीकृत्य च यत्पार्थांस्तव पुत्रो ववल्ग ह ।
विषमस्थान्समस्थो हि संरम्भाद्गतचेतसः ॥

meaning.en: and how your son strutted, holding the Parthas as straw, he himself in a level place while they were in a rough one, with minds lost in rage.

verses.text:
बाल्यात्प्रभृति चारिघ्नस्तानि दुःखानि चिन्तयन् ।
निरविद्यत धर्मात्मा जीवितेन वृकोदरः ॥

meaning.en: Remembering from boyhood those sorrows, Vrikodara, slayer of foes, the righteous one, grew weary of life.

verses.text:
ततो विस्फार्य सुमहद्धेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम् ।
चापं भरतशार्दूलस्त्यक्तात्मा कर्णमभ्ययात् ॥

meaning.en: Then, flexing that very great, gold-backed, hard-to-withstand bow, that tiger of the Bharatas, giving up his own life, went at Karna.

verses.text:
स सायकमयैर्जालैर्भीमः कर्णरथं प्रति ।
भानुमद्भिः शिलाधौतैर्भानोः प्रच्छादयत्प्रभाम् ॥

meaning.en: With nets of arrows, shining, whetted on stone, Bhima covered the sun's brilliance as he came toward Karna's chariot.

verses.text:
ततः प्रहस्याधिरथिस्तूर्णमस्यञ्शिताञ्शरान् ।
व्यधमद्भीमसेनस्य शरजालानि पत्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Laughing, Adhiratha's son quickly shot sharp arrows and broke Bhimasena's nets of arrows with his feathered shafts.

verses.text:
महारथो महाबाहुर्महावेगैर्महाबलः ।
विव्याधाधिरथिर्भीमं नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: The mighty-armed great chariot-warrior of great force and great speed, the son of Adhiratha, pierced Bhima with nine sharp arrows.

verses.text:
स तोत्त्रैरिव मातङ्गो वार्यमाणः पतत्रिभिः ।
अभ्यधावदसंभ्रान्तः सूतपुत्रं वृकोदरः ॥

meaning.en: Held back by those arrows as an elephant by goads, Vrikodara rushed unflustered at the charioteer's son.

verses.text:
तमापतन्तं वेगेन रभसं पाण्डवर्षभम् ।
कर्णः प्रत्युद्ययौ योद्धुं मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम् ॥

meaning.en: As he rushed on with speed and fury, that bull of the Pandavas, Karna went out to fight him, like a rutting elephant against a rutting elephant.

verses.text:
ततः प्रध्माप्य जलजं भेरीशतनिनादितम् ।
अक्षुभ्यत बलं हर्षादुद्धूत इव सागरः ॥

meaning.en: Then, after blowing their conches and with hundreds of drums sounding, the force surged with joy like an ocean stirred up.

verses.text:
तदुद्धूतं बलं दृष्ट्व रथनागाश्वपत्तिमत् ।
भीमः कर्णं समासाद्य छादयामास सायकैः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that force stirred up, with its chariots, elephants, horses and foot soldiers, Bhima reached Karna and covered him with arrows.

verses.text:
अश्वानृश्यसवर्णांस्तु हंसवर्णैर्हयोत्तमैः ।
व्यामिश्रयद्रणे कर्णः पाण्डवं छादयञ्शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Karna mixed the horses, dark as deer, with the best horses of swan-white, in the battle, covering the Pandava with arrows.

verses.text:
ऋश्यवर्णान्हयान्कर्कैर्मिश्रान्मारुतरंहसः ।
निरीक्ष्य तव पुत्राणां हाहाकृतमभूद्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the deer-colored horses mixed with the gray-white ones, wind-swift, your sons' army cried out in dismay.

verses.text:
ते हया बह्वशोभन्त मिश्रिता वातरंहसः ।
सितासिता महाराज यथा व्योम्नि बलाहकाः ॥

meaning.en: Those mixed wind-swift horses, white and dark, shone greatly, great king, like clouds in the sky.

verses.text:
संरब्धौ क्रोधताम्राक्षौ प्रेक्ष्य कर्णवृकोदरौ ।
संत्रस्ताः समकम्पन्त त्वदीयानां महारथाः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Karna and Vrikodara furious, with eyes red with rage, the great chariot-warriors of your side trembled in fear.

verses.text:
यमराष्ट्रोपमं घोरमासीदायोधनं तयोः ।
दुर्दर्शं भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रेतराजपुरं यथा ॥

meaning.en: Their battleground was dreadful like the realm of Yama, hard to look at, best of Bharatas, like the city of the king of the dead.

verses.text:
समाजमिव तच्चित्रं प्रेक्षमाणा महारथाः ।
नालक्षयञ्जयं व्यक्तमेकैकस्य निवारणे ॥

meaning.en: The great chariot-warriors, watching that wondrous scene as at a festival, did not see a clear victory in either, as each held the other back.

verses.text:
तयोः प्रैक्षन्त संमर्दं संनिकृष्टमहास्त्रयोः ।
तव दुर्मन्त्रिते राजन्सपुत्रस्य विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: They watched the clash of those two, with great weapons in close play, the result, O king, of your and your sons' evil counsel, lord of the people.

verses.text:
छादयन्तौ हि शत्रुघ्नावन्योन्यं सायकैः शितैः ।
शरजालावृतं व्योम चक्राते शरवृष्टिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Covering each other with sharp arrows, those two slayers of foes made the sky veiled with nets of arrows with their showers.

verses.text:
तावन्योन्यं जिघांसन्तौ शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्महारथौ ।
प्रेक्षणीयतरावास्तां वृष्टिमन्ताविवाम्बुदौ ॥

meaning.en: Wishing to kill each other with sharp arrows, those two great chariot-warriors were more splendid to see, like two rain-bearing clouds.

verses.text:
सुवर्णविकृतान्बाणान्प्रमुञ्चन्तावरिंदमौ ।
भास्वरं व्योम चक्राते वह्न्युल्काभिरिव प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: Letting fly arrows wrought of gold, those two tamers of foes made the sky bright as if with fire-brands, lord.

verses.text:
ताभ्यां मुक्ता व्यकाशन्त कङ्कबर्हिणवाससः ।
पङ्क्त्यः शरदि मत्तानां सारसानामिवाम्बरे ॥

meaning.en: The arrows loosed by them, feathered with heron and peacock plumes, shone like lines of rutting cranes in the autumn sky.

verses.text:
संसक्तं सूतपुत्रेण दृष्ट्वा भीममरिंदमम् ।
अतिभारममन्येतां भीमे कृष्णधनंजयौ ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Bhima, tamer of foes, locked with the charioteer's son, Krishna and Dhananjaya felt the burden on Bhima was very heavy.

verses.text:
तत्राधिरथिभीमाभ्यां शरैर्मुक्तैर्दृढाहताः ।
इषुपातमतिक्रम्य पेतुरश्वनरद्विपाः ॥

meaning.en: There the elephants, horses and men, struck hard by the arrows loosed by Adhiratha's son and Bhima, fell beyond arrow-range.

verses.text:
पतद्भिः पतितैश्चान्यैर्गतासुभिरनेकशः ।
कृतो महान्महाराज पुत्राणां ते जनक्षयः ॥

meaning.en: With many falling and fallen, others lifeless, a great slaughter of your sons' people was made, great king.

verses.text:
मनुष्याश्वगजानां च शरीरैर्गतजीवितैः ।
क्षणेन भूमिः संजज्ञे संवृता भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: In a moment the ground was covered, O best of Bharatas, with the bodies of men, horses and elephants whose lives had gone.
